about_the_game:
Have you ever wanted to pile up your toys to make a track for your radio-controlled cars?  Obstacle Overdrive offers room after room of tracks to explore that would ordinarily get you in trouble.  Parents not included. 

Not a Racing Game:  Master the control of each car and take on crazy tracks filled with obstacles.  Take your time and enjoy the challenge of each obstacle. 

Five Unique Cars:  Each of the cars you unlock while playing has its own personality and driving style.  See if you can beat every level with each car!

Fun Physics:  Tumble down hills, go car bowling, drive over seesaws and log bridges, go through marble pits, and more!

Collect and Customize:  Discover fun hats for the cars scattered throughout the game.  Use coins to unlock new paint jobs to personalize each car. 

90s Nostalgia:  Come back in time with us to the 1990s, before tech took over our lives and we had to make our own entertainment.

short_description: Cruise through a world of colorful retro inspired toys in Obstacle Overdrive, a cozy off-roading toy car adventure! Navigate fun, challenging courses, tumultuous tumbles, and enjoy the charm of a miniature world where the obstacles are as playful as the ride itself.
